flashcards.front: What is the purpose of database normalization?
flashcards.back: To organise a relational database to reduce redundancy and avoid update, insert, and delete anomalies.
Every attribute holds atomic (indivisible) values and there are no repeating groups.
It matters only when the key is composite.

flashcards.front: What is prohibited in 3NF regarding dependencies?
flashcards.back: There are no transitive dependencies, meaning a non-key attribute must not depend on another non-key attribute.

flashcards.front: Why is denormalization sometimes done on purpose?
flashcards.back: To speed up read-heavy queries, at the cost of extra storage and redundancy.
